method: Each page was fetched once with a single request, parsed directly, and judged on what it states. Search-engine summaries were used only to find pages and are never evidence. No paywall, bot protection or HTTP restriction was bypassed and nothing was bulk scraped.

policy.store: individual source-stated facts with a citation and a short DISI paraphrase (<= 300 characters)
policy.terms: Baseball America material is treated as all-rights-reserved: facts and citations only.

sources.source: Baseball America, International Reviews: Los Angeles Dodgers (2015-16 class), Ben Badler, 2016-04-01
sources.names_network_explicitly: yes, per player, in the source's own wording

known_gaps: Only two readable public pages state a network relationship for a DISI-tracked player, so the seed is five players.
The four MLB.com candidates (Morales, Arias, Melburne, Vargas) remain unverified.
No public structured source of trainer relationships was found.
